# deploy/env

| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `public.env` | Committed, non-secret identifiers: Convex Cloud deployment names and URLs, site URLs, Stripe object ids, bucket names, PostHog/DataFast public ids. Read by `deploy.sh` (docker build args), `convex-cloud-env.py`, `server-env.py`, the CI workflows and `deploy/tests/contracts.test.sh`. |
| `server/<file>.env` | Templates of the root-only env files of the Hetzner services. `deploy/scripts/server-env.py` renders them from `public.env`, `.env` and `.env.keys` (repo root, never committed) and writes `/opt/desyn/secrets/<file>.env` on the server. |

Secrets have exactly two homes:

1. `.env.keys` (and `.env`) on the owner's workstation, never committed, never printed by any script.
2. Their rendered copies: the Convex Cloud deployment env (`convex-cloud-env.py prod`) and
   `/opt/desyn/secrets/*.env` on the server (`server-env.py prod --host hetzner`; directory `0700`, files `0600`,
   owner root). Both are regenerated on every `deploy.sh` run; never edit them by hand on the server.

## Server env files

| File | Read by | Contents (names) | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `web.env` | `web-blue` / `web-green` | `DESYN_EDITION`, `SITE_URL`, `APP_URL`, `DOCS_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` URLs, `CONVEX_URL`, `CONVEX_SITE_URL`, PostHog/DataFast public ids, `LOG_LEVEL` | `public.env` |
| `landing.env` | `landing-blue` / `landing-green` | as `web.env` without `LOG_LEVEL`/`POSTHOG_HOST` | `public.env` |
| `docs.env` | `docs-blue` / `docs-green` | `DESYN_EDITION`, URLs, `DOCS_SITE_URL`, public analytics ids | `public.env` |
| `worker.env` | `worker-blue` / `worker-green` | `RENDER_WORKER_SECRET`, `RUST_LOG` | `.env.keys` `RENDER_WORKER_SECRET_PROD` (generated by `convex-cloud-env.py`, so Convex Cloud and the worker share it) |
| `backup.env` | `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` (aws-cli container) | `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `BACKUP_S3_BUCKET`, `BACKUP_S3_PREFIX`, `BACKUP_S3_REGION`, `BACKUP_ASSETS_BUCKET`, `BACKUP_INCLUDE_FILE_STORAGE`, `BACKUP_LOCAL_RETENTION_DAYS` (optional: `BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT`, `BACKUP_REMOTE_PRUNE`, `BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS`) | `.env.keys` `BACKUP_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `BACKUP_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` (IAM user `desyn-backup`), `public.env` buckets |
| `convex-backup.env` | `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` (Convex CLI container only) | `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY` | `.env.keys` `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY_PROD`; created once by `server-env.py` with the owner's `npx convex login` when missing |
| `axiom.env` | `desyn-logship.service` (Vector) | `AXIOM_TOKEN`, `AXIOM_DATASET` | `.env.keys`; optional file, skipped while `AXIOM_TOKEN` is absent |

Optional, not generated: `/opt/desyn/secrets/build.env` with public `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` overrides for the image builds
(non-empty values win over `public.env`).

## Template syntax

One `NAME=TEMPLATE` per line; `#` lines are comments. In `TEMPLATE`:

- `${A}` is required: the value of `A` from the sources (`.env.keys` wins over `.env`, which wins over `public.env`).
- `${A|B}` takes the first of `A`, `B` that has a value.
- `${A:-text}` falls back to the literal `text`; `${A:-}` makes the line optional (dropped when empty).
- A file whose first comment contains `@optional-file` is skipped instead of failing when a required name is missing.

Values must be single-line and free of whitespace, quotes, `$` and backslashes, because the same file is read by
docker compose `env_file` (which interpolates `$`) and by `docker run --env-file` (which keeps quotes). The script
refuses other values and names the variable, never the value.

Check what is missing without writing anything: `python3 deploy/scripts/server-env.py prod --check`.
